en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a villa with a decorative facade, surrounded by trees and a gated fence. The typed text at the top left reads 'Bad Pyrmont. St. Georgs-Villa.' The reverse of the postcard has handwritten German text, a postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich, a postmark from 'Bad Pyrmont' dated 1919, and a stamp indicating it is part of the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont' collection.
